title: 2 CFR 200.1 Definitions
publisher: Office of Management and Budget (eCFR, National Archives)
summary: The definitions section of the Uniform Guidance, read on the eCFR as current to 10/01/2026. It settles the meaning of grant agreement, cooperative agreement, recipient, subrecipient, pass-through entity, period of performance, indirect cost and modified total direct costs, and it carries the $10,000 equipment figure and the $50,000 subaward figure in MTDC.
why_it_mattered: The definitions section of the Uniform Guidance. key_facts: MTDC includes up to the first $50,000 of each subaward, regardless of the period of performance of the subawards under the award.

Equipment: tangible personal property with a useful life of more than one year and a per-unit acquisition cost that equals or exceeds the lesser of the recipient's capitalization level or $10,000.
A cooperative agreement provides for substantial involvement of the Federal agency or pass-through entity in carrying out the activity; a grant agreement does not.
Micro-purchase threshold and simplified acquisition threshold are tied to the amounts set by the FAR at 48 CFR part 2, subpart 2.1.
Assistance listings: the publicly available listing of Federal assistance programs managed by GSA at SAM.gov.
An institution of higher education is defined by reference to 20 U.S.C. 1001; a nonprofit organization in this part is not an IHE.
